title: Netflix Just Passed Cable In Total Subscribers
source: Netflix quarterly shareholder letters (UCAN region paid streaming memberships) and Leichtman Research Group's count of major US pay-TV (cable/satellite/telco) subscribers, as reported in LRG press releases and by Forbes and Fortune. Subscribers (millions) - Netflix UCAN: ~33.4 (2013), ~44.7 (2015), ~58.4 (2017), ~67.7 (2019), ~75.2 (2021), ~89.9 (2023). Major US pay-TV providers: ~94.2 (2013), ~92.9 (2015), ~89.0 (2017), ~84.0 (2019), ~74.0 (2021), ~64.9 (2023, after LRG reported major providers lost about 5 million subscribers that year). Streaming subscriber counts overtook traditional pay-TV around 2021.
